dialog.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter. Cannot be changed later.

dialog.title: Separation: {scope}
dialog.retentionNote: At most {hours} hours: separation is checked against the aired history, which is kept for the play log retention period (Settings).

edit.limitsNote: Set at least one limit. Every limit you set must pass for the track to play. Times are station time.
edit.weekdaysNote: No day chosen means every day. With a window that crosses midnight (22:00 to 02:00), the day is the one on which the window starts.

errors.atLeastOne: Set at least one limit: a time window, weekdays, a minimum interval, or plays per hour.
errors.sameWindow: The window must end at a different time than it starts.

edit.filePathHint: Relative to the media folder, with forward slashes, for example music/song.mp3.
edit.durationEmpty: Left empty, the length is read from the file. A track without a length cannot be planned.

tracks.label: Tracks in this playlist ({count})
tracks.poolNote: A playlist is a pool: the order of its tracks does not matter, and the system chooses the track.
tracks.filter: Filter the tracks of this playlist
tracks.more: {count} more tracks are not shown. Use the filter to find them.

edit.elementsNote: The order of flow elements is the order of play. Start and end elements open and close the hour; fixed elements start at their minute.

element.title: Element {number}
element.defaultTolerance: Empty: the default from the settings

check.title: Dry check
check.incompleteNote: A short segment has no filler. Reminders are created for its hours until you choose one.
check.shortfall: The clock is short by {duration} in total.
check.replaced: These fixed elements were replaced by a new element at the same time:

warnings.element_no_tracks: Element {element}: its playlists have no track with a known duration.
warnings.element_no_fitting_track: Element {element}: no track fits the nominal duration within the tolerance.
warnings.element_few_tracks: Element {element}: too few fitting tracks for the separation rules; tracks may repeat or be skipped.
warnings.element_blocked_by_play_rules: Element {element}: play rules block every fitting track in these grid hours: {hours}.
warnings.segment_overflow: Segment {segment} runs past the end of the hour; the last track is cut and faded out.

layout.title: Layout of the hour (nominal durations)
layout.stale: This is the layout as saved. Save to check your changes.
layout.caption: Segments of the hour

pool.title: Filler pool
pool.note: Specific tracks used one after another when a segment in pool mode needs filler. Used tracks stay listed as history.

week.title: Week from {from} to {to}
week.note: Hours and dates are in the station timezone ({zone}). Use + in a cell to add its weekday and hour to the change below.
week.caption: Clocks by hour for the week

change.title: Change the grid
change.note: The clock is assigned to every chosen weekday at every chosen hour, for the dates given. Existing slots there are replaced for those dates.
